items.title: First on-demand pill for hereditary angioedema attacks recommended for NHS use
items.summary: NICE highlighted Ekterly’s advantages such as convenience and easier self-administration compared to injectable treatments.

items.title: Pharming Group pauses Ruconest manufacturing in US
items.summary: Pharming Group has temporarily paused the manufacturing of Ruconest and alerted the US FDA on anticipated supply constraints across the country.

items.title: Bayer signs $3.25bn oncology deal with Hansoh Pharma
items.summary: Bayer has entered into an exclusive worldwide licensing agreement potentially valued at up to $3.25bn with Hansoh Pharma to develop, manufacture, and commercialise the Phase I oncology candidate HS-20122.

items.title: AI could help with early diagnosis of breast cancer
items.summary: The UK NHS has launched the EDITH trial with 700,000 women, making it the world's largest trial of AI in breast cancer screening.

items.title: Cogent Biosciences gains FDA approval for Ekitna combo in GIST
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Cogent Biosciences’ Ekitna in combination with sunitinib for adult patients with advanced GIST who previously received imatinib.
